channel.title: Cluster Members on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Cluster Members on KubeSphere

item.title: Invite Users to a Cluster
item.description: This section describes how to invite users to a cluster. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Member Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. A user has been created in User and Role Management. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member Management permissions and enter your cluster.

item.title: View Cluster Member List
item.description: This section describes how to view the cluster member list. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Member View permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member View permissions and enter your cluster. Click Cluster Settings > Cluster Members in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Modify Cluster Member Roles
item.description: This section describes how to modify the roles of cluster members. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Member Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member Management permissions and enter your cluster. Click Cluster Settings > Cluster Members in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Remove Cluster Members
item.description: This section describes how to remove cluster members. Note After a user is removed from the cluster, they will lose the permissions granted by the cluster role. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Member Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member Management permissions and enter your cluster.
